verdict.rationale: The evidence documents only Statsig acting as an MCP server that exposes its functionality to external clients like Cursor, Claude Code, and ChatGPT. That is the server role and cannot be credited to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Statsig itself connecting to or consuming third-party MCP servers' tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
